sql_templates.description: Retrieve latest FII/DII flows, market regime, and breadth data to evaluate market context.
sql_templates.name: QuarterToDateFiiDiiRegimeBreadth
sql_templates.sql:
WITH latest_data AS (SELECT MAX(trade_date) AS latest_date FROM signals.fii_dii_flows),
latest_flows AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM signals.fii_dii_flows
    WHERE trade_date = (SELECT latest_date FROM latest_data)
),
latest_regime AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM signals.regime_history
    WHERE trade_date = (SELECT latest_date FROM latest_data)
),
latest_breadth AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM breadth.market_daily
    WHERE trade_date = (SELECT latest_date FROM latest_data)
)
SELECT
    lf.trade_date,
    lf.fii_net_today, lf.dii_net_today, lf.flow_signal,
    lr.regime, lr.confidence,
    lb.advances, lb.declines, lb.ad_signal
FROM
    latest_flows lf
JOIN
    latest_regime lr ON lf.trade_date = lr.trade_date
JOIN
    latest_breadth lb ON lf.trade_date = lb.trade_date;

validation_rules: {'rules': ['Ensure all SQL templates are read-only and return expected fields.', 'Confirm schema adherence by cross-referencing approved tables and columns.', 'SQL should utilize latest-date filtering as per global rules.']}
